items.question: Can offers be combined?
items.answer: Ask in store which offers can be combined. Each campaign states its own dates and conditions on its offer page. Exchanging old gold is a standing promise rather than a campaign offer; ask at the counter how it applies alongside the offer you have in mind.

items.question: Do offers apply at all branches?
items.answer: Yes, unless the offer page names specific branches. Offers are applied in store, so message us on WhatsApp to check which pieces qualify at the branch you plan to visit.

items.question: How do I claim an offer?
items.answer: Mention the offer at the counter before the invoice is raised, or ask on WhatsApp first and we will confirm which pieces qualify and what the offer covers. Offers run only for the dates stated on the offer page.
